thread:
Clara: Quick sync  prepping AWS/GCP/Azure listings for Partner X. Need publisher proof (Azure), GCP service account + roles, localized T&Cs, and marketing assets. Who can take images/AMI/container artifacts?
Miguel: I can own AMIs and container images. What manifest shape do marketplaces want? Any limits on screenshot sizes or filetypes? :camera_flash:
Priya: Legal heads-up: telemetry opt-out language must be explicit, and EU residency option needs to be selectable. Also confirm BYO KMS support in the listing flow.
Leo: Ops notes for GCP: create a service account with roles compute.viewer, storage.objectViewer, logging.logWriter. We also need a pubsub topic or webhook for billing callbacks.
Dana: Billing will need a test callback endpoint + sample payload. Proposed SKU naming: rw-inference.hosted.v1, rw-inference.dedicated.v1, rw-inference.bundle.enterprise. Keep ids short and stable.
MarketplaceBot: [workflow created] ONB-7822: Partner X marketplace onboarding plan created.
Clara: Also need logos: 1:1 PNG (512x512) and banner 4:1 (1600x400), privacy policy URL, and support contact email. Marketing will review copy.
Miguel: Uploading assets to CDN now: https://internal.cdn/redwood/partners/partnerx/assets.zip. Will add checksums.
Priya: Azure-specific: publisher attestation + extra verification step. Expect +3 business days for Azure publish paperwork. Also tax docs may be required per region.
Leo: Staging regions we want parity in: aws-us-west-2, gcp-europe-west1, azure-northeurope. Requesting test accounts in each region for latency/baseline tests.
Dana: Pricing proposal: per-token metered + optional monthly commitment. Metered metrics: input_tokens, output_tokens. Example rate: $0.45 / 1k tokens. We'll include a trial bucket for 30 days.
Clara: I'll draft listing copy with feature bullets, security section (KMS options, audit logs), and a short install flow. Will ping legal + marketing for signoff.
MarketplaceBot: ONB-7822 updated: assets uploaded by Miguel.
Priya: Add data retention window choices (90 days, 365 days) to the manifest. Partners frequently ask. Also need to surface whether we expose audit logs via API.
Miguel: AMI IDs for aws-us-west-2: ami-0c1a2b3c4d5e6f70. Container image tags pushed to internal registry: partnerx/rw-inference:2026-03-01.
Dana: Test acceptance criteria: 1) install, 2) authenticate, 3) first inference, 4) billing event appears, 5) deprovision. Recommend a partner dry-run next Thursday.
Clara: I'll turn this into the marketplace checklist and assign follow-ups in ONB-7822. Thanks everyone :sparkles:
